mapvcpoweredbyalert:
BTCMap.org uses OpenStreetMap to tag places that accept bitcoin, and display those merchants in their beautiful apps.

Their apps and the underlying data are free and open-source.

Neither bittr nor BTCMap.org receives your location. Your phone downloads the whole list of places and picks out the nearby ones itself.

The map itself is drawn by a map provider, which sees the area on your screen — and if you allow location, that starts with the area around you.
